example.title: Frank Pisar (Pisar-Kastanek) farmstead, 1950s farmhouse
example.place: Pleasant Hill vicinity, Saline County, NE

brief: Plain post-war one-and-a-half-storey farmhouse: a steep side-gabled roof of grey asphalt shingles with one wide shed dormer holding a triple window, white aluminum lap siding, paired one-over-one windows with little aluminum awning brackets, and a brick chimney on the ridge. A small shed-roofed back porch on thin pipe posts at one end. A silver propane tank sits in the weeds against the wall; a white steel machine shed on one side and the old stone barn on the other, fields right up to the yard.
